AI system shows no recent learning cycles, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential system slowdowns or failures.
Review and potentially adjust trading strategies to ensure they are executing trades as expected.
Evaluate AI system performance and ensure it is properly configured to generate trading opportunities and make adjustments.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, affecting the platform's performance and user experience.
